gloss: below one's eyes; the view below

definitions.gloss: below one's eyes; the view below
definitions.explanation: The area seen when looking down from a high place, such as a mountain, a tower or a plane. Almost always used as {眼下|がんか}に (spread out below) or {眼下|がんか}の (below).

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{眼下|がんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: From the summit I looked down on the town below.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{眼下|がんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のんだ。
examples.english: When I went up to the observation deck, the night view of Tokyo spreading out below took my breath away.

notes:
Made of {眼|がん} (eye) + {下|か} (below). A written, descriptive word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {眼下|がんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread out below
- {眼下|がんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧: to look down on
- {眼下|がんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: the view below

WATCH OUT:
It sounds the same as ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧ (ophthalmology, an eye clinic), the commoner word in speech.
